title: Leftward Walk During Register Printing
statement: Let $R\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Lambda$ be a finite set of labels, let $P$ be a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, and choose a start label $\ell_0\in\Lambda$. Fix an input bit string $x$, a register $r$, a label $\ell$, an input-head position $p$, work tapes $T_i:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1,\sqcup\}$ and work-head positions $h_i\in\mathbb{Z}$, and $m\in\mathbb{N}$; suppose tape $T_r$ has value $1$ exactly at the cells $0,\ldots,m-1$ and is blank elsewhere. For every $j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $j\le m$ and every output word $w$, starting in the print-left state for register $r$ and label $\ell$, with head $r$ at cell $j-1$ and the other data as specified, after $j+1$ steps the machine is in the print-right state for $r,\ell$, with head $r$ at cell $0$, unchanged input head and tapes, and output $w$ followed by $j$ copies of $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $R\in\mathbb{N}$ and the label set $\Lambda$ is finite.
$P$ is a counter program over $R$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$.
An input bit string $x$ is fixed.
A register $r$ and label $\ell$ are specified.
Work tapes $T_i:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1,\sqcup\}$ and head positions $h_i\in\mathbb{Z}$ are specified.
$m\in\mathbb{N}$ and tape $T_r$ equals one on cells $0\le c<m$ and is blank elsewhere.
replaced:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite set of labels, $P$ a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in
$\Lambda$, $\ell_0 \in \Lambda$, $x$ an input bit string, $r$ a register, $\ell$ a label, $p$ an
input-head position, $(T_i)$ work tapes and $(h_i)$ work heads, and $m \in \mathbb{N}$ such that
tape $r$ is the unary tape $T_r = 1^m$ (cells $0, \dots, m-1$ hold $1$, all others blank). Then
for every $j \le m$ and every output string $w$, running the machine of $P$ started at $\ell_0$
for $j + 1$ steps from the configuration in state $\mathsf{print}_{\leftarrow}(r, \ell)$ with
input head $p$, tapes $(T_i)$, heads $(h_i)$ except that head $r$ is on cell $j - 1$, and output
$w$, reaches the configuration in state $\mathsf{print}_{\rightarrow}(r, \ell)$ with input head
$p$, tapes $(T_i)$, heads $(h_i)$ except that head $r$ is on cell $0$, and output $w\,1^j$.
